environments.title: Oceanum environments
environments.description: The Oceanum deployments this JupyterLab may sign in to, matched against the page hostname. Leave empty on an ordinary JupyterLab: with no environment declared there is no sign-in on offer, and the top bar carries no account control. JupyterLite deployments are configured through jupyter-lite.json instead (litePluginSettings), and both sources are used when both are present, these first. Each entry needs hosts, auth0Domain, clientId, oceanumDomain and urls.datamesh/specs/manage; urls.datameshUi and urls.ai are optional. Note that hosts are matched against window.location.hostname exactly, so "localhost" does not match a page served from 127.0.0.1.

hosts.title: Page hostnames served by this environment

signInRedirect.title: Check for an existing session with a full-page redirect
signInRedirect.description: Only for an Auth0 tenant on another site than this one, where browsers blocking third-party cookies hide the session from the silent iframe check. The site origin must be an allowed callback URL.
